findings.locator: b00010, PDF page10, printed Cell page320, Experimental Procedures: Preparation of DNase I-Treated DNA
findings.targeted_primary_finding: Boyle Solexa DNase-seq attaches a biotinylated linker containing an MmeI site to DNase-digested ends, uses MmeI digestion and streptavidin enrichment, then linkerII/PCR. The carrier is selected cleaved-end DNA; the primary does not establish that the Illumina Isolate trimmed complexes icon depicts this route.
findings.quote: After MmeI digestion, DNase ends were enriched on streptavidin beads
findings.proposed_use: Resolve the Boyle implementation-specific recovery interface while preserving the literal diagram as a separate source claim. Do not invent retained protein-complex capture.

findings.locator: b00005, PDF page5, printed14930, Discussion and Methods: Preparation of DNA for ChIP-Seq and Sono-Seq; b00006 yeast preparation; page1 results for common size-selected DNA/library endpoint
findings.targeted_primary_finding: The primary explicitly contrasts FAIRE extraction before crosslink reversal with Sono crosslink reversal before phenol/chloroform extraction. The HeLa Sono Methods reserve clarified lysate for crosslink reversal followed by RNase/proteinaseK and DNA purification. The paper reports size-selected DNA entering library construction; yeast Methods explicitly put purification before 100–350bp size selection.
findings.quote: the protein-DNA cross-links are reversed before phenol-chloroform extraction
findings.proposed_use: Separate the two method-specific extraction interfaces. Do not merge size-selection, organic-phase selection and crosslink order solely because the catalogue groups names.

findings.locator: b00031, repository-covered author manuscript PDF page31, Supplementary figure1 caption, panelb; b00019, library Methods
findings.targeted_primary_finding: Capture-C sonicates purified/de-crosslinked 3C ligation products, ligates Illumina adapters, enriches target ends by hybridization to biotinylated RNA capture probes and streptavidin pull-down, then amplifies the captured library. The biotin is on the capture probe, not established as a ligation-junction tag. The Methods separately state that adapter-ligated library is input to SureSelect enrichment.
findings.quote: 120 bp biotinylated RNA SureSelect capture probes and streptavidin pull down
findings.proposed_use: Refine Capture-C-specific probe/carrier placement. Keep the unlabelled orange join unresolved and distinct from Hi-C biotin fill-in.
findings.edition: repository-covered accepted author manuscript; not claimed identical to publisher version
